welcome.title: Your AI coworkers, in your pocket.
welcome.intro: This app controls the Godmode running on your computer. Pair it once with the code on your computer's screen.
welcome.removed: This phone was removed on your computer. Scan a new code to connect again.

handOver.title: Hand over work from anywhere
handOver.body: Start a task, follow the answer as it's written, stop it with one tap.

watch.title: Look over their shoulder
watch.body: Watch the browser, shared screen or VM an agent works in, live.

inCharge.title: Your computer stays in charge
inCharge.body: Your phone reaches it over Tailscale or Godmode Cloud with a key of its own, which the computer can revoke anytime. Logins stay on the computer.

welcome.howTo:
On your computer: Settings → Phone → Connect a phone.
Tailscale on both (same account), or the computer linked to Godmode Cloud.

invalid.title: Not a Godmode code
invalid.body: Open Settings → Phone on your computer and scan the code shown there.

pair.title: Connect to {{name}}?
pair.body: This phone gets its own key and can control Godmode on this computer.
pair.expired: This code has expired. Show a new one on your computer.

scan.notGodmode: That's not a Godmode code. Open Settings → Phone on your computer.
scan.copyFirst: Copy the pairing link on your computer first.

camera.title: Camera access
camera.why: Godmode only uses the camera to read the pairing code on your computer.
camera.off: Camera access is off. Turn it on in Settings, or paste the pairing link instead.

scan.point: Point at the code on your computer
